svg.title: Shopping, tiered like loot
svg.desc: Performance-tiered Shopping as a loot filter. Heroes: Spend and convert. Scale them. Sidekicks: Convert on little spend. Feed them. Villains: Spend without converting. Fix or cut. Zombies: Barely served. Wake them or bin them. Tiered per variant, with the parent range as the fallback when data is thin.
svg.text: Convert on little spend. Feed them.
Spend without converting. Fix or cut.
Barely served. Wake them or bin them.
Tiered per variant. Thin data falls back to the parent range.
